title: College enrollment at named campuses, replacing MTC's 2023 land-use figure for their block group
why: MTC's 2023 land use (TM1 TAZ1454: COLLFTE + 0.5 COLLPTE, shared out by education jobs in zones.ts) puts 27,269 students at San Francisco State's block group, more than the university's own headcount in any recent year; SF State has shrunk every year since 2019.

campuses.name: San Francisco State University
campuses.source: California State University, Enrollment by Campus, fall 2025 (https://www.calstate.edu/csu-system/about-the-csu/facts-about-the-csu/enrollment), as reported in the Golden Gate Xpress (https://goldengatexpress.org/113580/news/campus/a-one-sided-enrollment-battle-sjsu-booms-while-sfsu-shrinks/): 20,713, 7.4% below fall 2024
campuses.residentShareSource: SF State 2018 Transportation Survey Results (Nelson\Nygaard), Figure 3-4: 41% of affiliates live in San Francisco (student-travel.json)
campuses.pass: Gator Pass: unlimited rides on all Bay Area operators that take Clipper (Clipper BayPass) since August 26, 2024; unlimited Muni since 2017-18. A mandatory fee of $130 a semester, so no fare per ride (student-travel.json)
